For nutrition: protein at every meal is the single most important default. Most men doing this plan should target 0.7 to 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight per day.

chunks.title: Workout plan for software engineers
chunks.text: That is the range that supports muscle building and hunger control without requiring obsessive tracking. If you are also trying to lose fat, create a moderate calorie deficit — 300 to 500 calories below maintenance — but protect protein first. Cutting calories without protecting protein erodes the muscle the lifting is building. For daily movement: a coding day is a sedentary day by default. Pair the plan above with a walk before work and a walk after the laptop closes. Those two anchors add 20 to 30 minutes of daily movement and create psychological boundaries that separate work from rest. On non-training days, add a midday walk as well.

chunks.title: Workout plan for software engineers
chunks.text: If you have a walking pad, use it during calls and shallow admin blocks at 1 to 1.5 mph. If you work from home, the kitchen also needs structure. Remote workers accumulate up to 110 more minutes of sitting per day than office workers and tend to snack more because the kitchen is always nearby. Batch-prepare proteins, keep water at the desk, and set a rule about eating during work hours. The training plan and the lifestyle structure have to work together. The fallback week Every developer has a week where the plan breaks. Production incident on Monday. On-call rotation. A release that runs until midnight. These weeks are not failure — they are part of the job. The plan needs a fallback.

chunks.title: Workout plan for software engineers
chunks.text: Two sessions is the floor: one squat-and-press day, one hinge-and-pull day. Each takes 30 minutes. Everything gets hit once instead of twice. It is not optimal and it does not need to be. It keeps the habit alive and keeps the main lifts moving, which is what protects months of progress from one bad week. The goal is not to optimize every week. The goal is to not quit. A floor of two sessions per week, reliably executed across 12 months, produces far more progress than an aggressive six-day plan that collapses after the first on-call rotation. When coaching helps If you keep researching, restarting, and redesigning the plan, the problem is not lack of information. It is lack of constraint.

chunks.text: A step-by-step macro setup for recomp: maintenance calories, protein, small deficit, fats, carbs, and weekly adjustments.. How to Calculate Macros for Body Recomposition. A practical step-by-step guide to setting calories, protein, carbs, and fats for body recomposition.. Find maintenance calories first. Use a TDEE estimate as the starting line. Body recomposition works best when you know roughly what keeps your weight stable before you choose a deficit.. Set protein before carbs and fats. Start with 0.8 to 1.0 grams of protein per pound of bodyweight. If you carry a lot of body fat, use goal bodyweight instead.. Use a small deficit, not a crash cut.

chunks.title: How to calculate macros for body recomposition
chunks.text: For most recomp phases, start around 10 to 15 percent below maintenance. That is enough to support fat loss without turning every lift into survival.. Set fats, then give the rest to carbs. A practical starting point is 25 to 30 percent of calories from fat, then the remaining calories from carbs so training performance does not disappear.. Adjust from weekly trends. Track weight average, waist, photos, strength, protein consistency, and training performance. One noisy day does not decide the plan.. Body recomposition macros. The mistake most people make with recomp macros. Most people try to make the macro split perfect before the training week is even real. They ask whether carbs should be 38 percent or 42 percent, but they have not trained hard three times this week, hit a protein floor, or checked whether their weight trend is stable.. If weight is not moving for two to three weeks and the waist is not changing, calories may be too high or tracking may be loose. If energy is fine but hunger is out of control, food choices and meal timing may need work before calories change..

chunks.text: Evidence-graded research on how acute and chronic alcohol intake affect male testosterone production, Leydig cell function, and hormonal recovery.. Alcohol and Testosterone: Acute vs. Chronic Effects and Recovery Kinetics. Heavy or chronic alcohol intake suppresses testosterone via Leydig cell impairment, while moderate drinking has transient effects. Peer-reviewed research and recovery kinetics.. Peer-reviewed evidence on how acute alcohol administration and chronic drinking affect male testosterone production, Leydig cells, and hormonal recovery.. What peer-reviewed clinical trials show regarding alcohol intake, Leydig cell suppression, LH pulsatility, and post-abstinence hormonal recovery..

chunks.title: Alcohol and Testosterone: Acute vs. Chronic Effects and Recovery Kinetics | Geebs Science
chunks.text: Because the majority of nocturnal testosterone and growth hormone pulses occur during deep SWS sleep stages, alcohol-induced sleep fragmentation exacerbates the hormonal suppression beyond the direct toxic effect of ethanol itself.. Does moderate drinking affect testosterone levels?. The impact of moderate alcohol consumption (1 to 3 standard drinks) is far milder than heavy bingeing, but controlled intervention trials show measurable effects over extended periods.

chunks.title: Alcohol and Testosterone: Acute vs. Chronic Effects and Recovery Kinetics | Geebs Science
chunks.text: In a 3-week diet-controlled randomized crossover trial by Sierksma et al. (2004) (PMID 15166654), healthy men consuming 40 grams of alcohol daily (~3 standard drinks) experienced a modest 6.8% reduction in total plasma testosterone levels compared to an alcohol-free control period.. A 3-week diet-controlled intervention of 40g alcohol daily produced a modest 6.8% drop in serum testosterone in healthy adult men.. Interestingly, acute low-dose ethanol administration (~0.5 g/kg, or about 2 drinks) can cause a brief, transient increase in measured circulating free testosterone (Sarkola et al., 2003, PMID 12711931).

chunks.title: Alcohol and Testosterone: Acute vs. Chronic Effects and Recovery Kinetics | Geebs Science
chunks.text: This acute phenomenon is driven by shifts in the hepatic NAD+/NADH ratio during alcohol oxidation, which transiently alters androgen metabolism in the liver rather than stimulating new testicular synthesis. This acute spike is short-lived and does not translate into enhanced anabolic capacity or physiological benefit.. Observed hormonal effect. Can testosterone levels recover after reducing alcohol intake?. Hormonal recovery kinetics following alcohol reduction or complete cessation depend on the duration and severity of previous drinking habits.

chunks.title: Alcohol and Testosterone: Acute vs. Chronic Effects and Recovery Kinetics | Geebs Science
chunks.text: Does a single beer drop your testosterone?. No. Low acute alcohol intake (roughly 0.5 g/kg or 1-2 standard drinks) does not suppress serum testosterone. In fact, low acute doses temporarily alter liver NAD+/NADH redox ratios, causing a brief, non-functional uptick in circulating free testosterone before returning to baseline.. How long does testosterone stay suppressed after heavy drinking?. Following heavy acute intoxication (1.5 g/kg ethanol), serum testosterone levels begin dropping within 2-4 hours and typically remain suppressed for 12 to 24 hours as ethanol and acetaldehyde metabolites clear the liver and testicular tissues.. Does moderate daily drinking impair testosterone long-term?.

chunks.title: Alcohol and Testosterone: Acute vs. Chronic Effects and Recovery Kinetics | Geebs Science

TDEE stands for Total Daily Energy Expenditure — the total calories your body burns in a day including resting metabolism, daily movement, and exercise. It is the calorie target for maintaining your current weight. Cuts go below TDEE, bulks go above.. Which BMR equation does this TDEE calculator use?. Mifflin-St Jeor.

chunks.title: TDEE calculator
chunks.text: It is the most accurate BMR equation for the general population per research validation, and it is the default used by registered dietitians. The formula is: 10 × weight (kg) + 6.25 × height (cm) − 5 × age + 5 (for males) or − 161 (for females).. How accurate is a TDEE calculator?. Within roughly ±10% for most people.
